lede: The week's most consequential meeting is Mountain Village Town Council on Thursday, August 20, where a resolution setting the sale price appreciation cap on deed-restricted units goes to a vote — that single decision shapes whether affordable housing in this valley actually stays affordable. Alongside that, Ouray County Planning Commission holds three public hearings Tuesday including a full repeal of Section 16 of its land use code, and Telluride's P&Z takes up school district employee housing and a cell tower public hearing the same evening. Tuesday also marks the first day of school for Telluride R-1.
